mapper.select: SELECT id, mapping_id, mq_type, server_addr, topic, routing_key, username, password, extra_config, created_at, updated_at FROM cdc_mq_target WHERE mapping_id = #{mappingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdc_mq_target (mapping_id, mq_type, server_addr, topic, routing_key, username, password, extra_config) VALUES (#{mappingId}, #{mqType}, #{serverAddr}, #{topic}, #{routingKey}, #{username}, #{password}, #{extraConfig})
mapper.update: UPDATE cdc_mq_target SET mq_type = #{mqType}, server_addr = #{serverAddr}, topic = #{topic}, routing_key = #{routingKey}, username = #{username}, password = #{password}, extra_config = #{extraConfig} WHERE mapping_id = #{mappingId}
